evidence.reason: The denylist scan invokes `gitleaks git` with log options but without `--text`. A PR can add a `.gitattributes` entry such as `credentials.txt -diff`, causing `git log -p` to emit a binary-file summary instead of the file content; gitleaks then has no text to scan, defeating the required fail-closed denylist. The same omission exists in the octopus scan at line 105. Adding `--text` to both log-opts, via the template and regenerated workflow, is the smallest compatible correction.
